F12 investigation checkpoint.

Step 0(a) found no existing ticket for the exact test name or for os.link snapshot materialization. Related active ticket famished-disgustful-gypsymoth covers fixture timeout enforcement. Related active ticket expectable-slowwitted-squeaker covers a 30 second local Git child timeout. Neither records an os.link stall in delta_tree.

Step 0(b) records the reported build as 8a036765705f5ef0e7db4fa21e0926e51d15bafd from the F12 worktree. Nineteen commits now separate it from origin/main. That range includes full-store scan reductions at 14aa285f963 and 37d29f017c8, plus transient store-read retry at 7825673f867. The directly implicated delta_tree path and test node did not change.

Step 0(c) uses isolated worktree /Users/joeoakhart/debug-f12-snapshot-link-stall at 51621917bfc635d7673cb0519a400afda12eb2cb, which matches origin/main.

The next experiment will run only the implicated test node on current main and capture duration and stack behavior. This distinguishes a current deterministic defect from a stale-base or suite-load interaction without rerunning the full suite.
